title: Checks for Mutex::lock calls in if let expression with lock calls in any of the else blocks.
summary: The Mutex lock remains held for the whole if let ... else block and deadlocks. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for usage of ! or != in an if condition with an else branch.
summary: Negations reduce the readability of statements. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for if/else with the same body as the then part and the else part.
summary: This is probably a copy & paste error. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for if-else that could be written using either bool::then or bool::then_some.
summary: Looks a little redundant. Using bool::then is more concise and incurs no loss of clarity. For simple calculations and known values, use bool::then_some, which is eagerly evaluated in comparison to bool::then. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for consecutive ifs with the same condition.
summary: This is probably a copy & paste error. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.
